verdict.rationale: Lago is a billing and subscription platform, so migrating live subscriptions in is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no import from spreadsheets or competing platforms, no migration tooling, and no PCI-compliant card data transfer. Assigning plans via the UI or API is only a developer building block, not a migration capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can migrate live subscriptions in from a spreadsheet or a competing platform — including PCI-compliant card data transfer — without customers noticing
